name: audio-visualizer
title: Audio Waveform Visualizer
author: Bevel UI <hello@bevelui.vercel.app>
description: Real-time Web Audio frequency and waveform analysis rendered as bars, an oscilloscope wave, or a circular spectrum. Connects to any <audio>/<video> element, a MediaStream (mic input), or an AudioBuffer.
docs: Import from @/components/bevelui/audio-visualizer. Wrap your player with AudioVisualizerRoot and a config. Call connect() with an HTMLMediaElement, MediaStream, or AudioBuffer from useAudioVisualizer, resume() the AudioContext from a user gesture, then start(). Renders bars, wave, or circular modes on a canvas that fills its container.
